name: mirage
text:
The Kalshi tab only shows while Kalshi is switched on. Open Settings, find the "Where to bet" card on the Settings home page, and turn Kalshi on. You can keep Novig on at the same time. The tab comes back with its Auto page. If Kalshi is already on there and the tab is still missing, tell me which app version you have and I will look into it.

If you bet from the +EV tab, that bet still follows the Kalshi daily limit, and the limit chips are on the Kalshi tab.
